visual_elements.description: Stacked multi-head self-attention diagram: five overlapping rounded rectangles offset diagonally (each successive layer up and to the right), representing heads h=1 (front, salmon pink, largest, fully detailed) through h=5 (back, cream, mostly occluded). FRONT LAYER (h=1) contents: (a) left column — four green-dashed input vector boxes X₁–X₄ (each ~5–6 cells, one cell pink-highlighted) → royal-blue matrix boxes labeled W^k [?] → small green vectors labeled K₁–K₄ [?] → tan 'Dot Product' box containing blue dot glyphs joined by thin lines (q₁·Kᵢ computations); white pill 'Similarity' above; (b) center — labels 'K·q' over '√d [?]' feed a vertical pink box 'Scaling by √d' (vertical text), then a vertical pink box 'Soft max' (vertical text); white pill 'Probabilities' above; (c) right — four green-dashed boxes X₁–X₄ → blue 'W^v' boxes → small vectors V₁–V₄ [?]; four red arrows from the softmax outputs each pass through a red ⊗ (circled multiply) symbol into a light-blue 'Σ' box; white pill 'Weighted SUM' above Σ; red output arrow exits the layer top; (d) bottom — row of four green-dashed boxes X₁–X₄ with X₂ filled pink; red arrow from X₂ up to a blue 'W^q' box producing vector 'q₁ [?]' that feeds the Dot Product box; a small thick red arrow outside the layer points at X₂. HIDDEN LAYERS (h=2–h=5): each shows its top edge with 'Similarity' pill, most show 'Weighted SUM' pill (h=2 also 'Probabilities'), a Σ box, and a red arrow rising to its colored Y output vector. Black ovals with white text h=1, h=2, h=3, h=4, h=5 descend diagonally along the layers' right edges.

Concatenation result at top: (1) small output vector box (~6 cells, one green highlighted cell = Y) labeled '1·d [?]' at top-center; (2) below it a wide pill-shaped bar with red outline divided into 5 segments — brown, dark gray, yellow, green, light green — each segment containing a mini multi-cell vector with one highlighted cell; red two-line label at the bar's left end: 'Concatenated Vector / 1·d [?]'; (3) five small head-output vectors (brown, dark gray, yellow, green, light green) stacked between the layers and the bar, each connected upward by a thin red arrow to its bar segment; the upper ones carry blue '1·d/H' labels.

Projection equation box (top-right): white rounded rectangle with green dashed border containing, left-to-right: a small vertical vector strip, bold black 'W', an '=' sign, and a small horizontal vector strip; blue dimension labels '1·d/H' beneath the strips; below the box, blue caption 'd : Embedding Length'; a black oval 'h=5' (white text) sits immediately left of the box.

Chunk-split table (bottom-right), introduced by bold black caption 'Split vectors into "H" chunks': five rows, one per head, top to bottom labeled 'To Head 5', 'To Head 4', 'To Head 3', 'To Head 2', 'To Head 1'. Each row contains four word boxes X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄, each word box partitioned into ~4–5 colored sub-chunks [?] (palette: green, yellow, purple, pink, red), with the sub-chunk belonging to that row's head emphasized in the row's color (row 1 green, row 2 yellow, row 3 purple, row 4 pink, row 5 red). Thin colored curved arrows lead from the rows leftward to the W-matrix columns and into the head layers.

Thick red curved arrow on the right side: tail near the lower-right (chunk-table / W-matrix region), sweeping up and left with a large arrowhead pointing into the right edge of the stacked layers near h=2/h=3; the red label '"H" Heads' is rotated ~90° along the arrow's upper portion. Additional thin colored (green/yellow/purple/pink/red) arrows connect the chunk rows and W-matrix columns to each layer's right edge.

Per-head weight-matrix columns (bottom-center-right): at least three diagonal groups of three small royal-blue matrix boxes labeled W^q, W^k, W^v with tiny head subscripts (e.g., W₁^q…W₅^v [?]; some groups partially occluded); thin colored arrows run from these boxes into the corresponding layers.
'Input Sequence' badge: red filled oval with white bold text, above four small dark-blue rectangular boxes containing 'X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄' in white; sits directly above the chunk-table caption.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title bold, ~28–32pt, black, with 'X₂' in red using a true subscript; subtitle '"Narrow" Architecture' bold with 'Narrow' in blue bold italic inside straight quotes. Diagram labels are very small (~8–12pt). Two boxes use vertical (rotated 90°) text: 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max'. Black ovals (h=1…h=5) use bold white text; white pills use small black text. Heavy use of subscripts (X₂, K₁, V₁, q₁, h=1) and superscripts (W^q, W^k, W^v). Red is reserved for arrows and emphasis; blue for matrices and dimension annotations; middle-dot '·' used in dimension labels (1·d, 1·d/H, K·q).
